name: Near and far content
responsibility: Draws both readings of a card or header around one shared icon chip
description: paintCardViews uses sharedChip and movingWords from far-view.ts: the chip sits outside both word layers, and the words share their first baseline while moving and scaling. From far the chip grows into a tile at the top of the face, where it stands near, and the far words start level with it. A container header and a sequence participant use the same card construction. paintHeadingViews draws a flow heading without a chip. document.ts supplies the swap rules.
